newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Central and West mill net profit up.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Central and West mill net profit up.

text.p: Egypt's Central and West Delta Flour Mills said on Monday its net after-tax profits rose to 43.121 million pounds ($12.68 million) in the financial year 1995/96 on 38.083 million in the previous year.
The financial year ends on June 30.
Shareholders' portion of distributable profits also rose to 38.218 million pounds, equivalent to about 5.00 pounds per share. This portion was 26.395 million in 94/95.
Brokers have said in September that Central and West Delta's unaudited net after-tax profits were 42.205 million pounds in the financial year 1995/96, against 38.07 million in 1994/5.
The firm said its turnover increased to 473.039 million pounds in 95/96 from 439.010 million in the previous year.
The firm showed no long-term loans last year, against 8.145 million pounds in 94/95.
The state privatised about 55 percent of the company's 7.5 million shares some three months ago at 40.00 pounds each.
The shares closed on the Egyptian stock exchange on Sunday at 90.00 pounds.
